description.value: You excel at junkomancy, the art of magically sculpting trash into less-useless trash. You have researched junkomancy extensively and can even cast junk spells beyond the magical traditions of your peers. You become an expert in Crafting. Add one common junk spell of any rank you can cast to your spell list. Whenever you gain another junkomancer feat, add another common junk spell of a rank you can cast to your spell list.

value.value: able to cast arcane or occult spells
